description: Jars for measuring false positives, drawn from Modrinth and CurseForge in four groups: the most downloaded mods at their newest release, the most downloaded for Minecraft 1.12.2 and for 1.7.10, and a seeded random draw from further down the rankings. Built by scripts/select-benchmark.py and downloaded into benchmark/cache by scripts/fetch-corpus.py benchmark/manifest.json. Every finding on these jars is labeled in benchmark/labels.json.
